glyph_origin: Originally written as 㤅. Phono-semantic compound (形聲): phonetic 旡 + semantic 心 (“heart”). As early as the Qin dynasty, a redundant component 夊 (“foot”) was added to the bottom of the character, as with some other characters depicting people. Compare 憂 (from 㥑). Hence, the character changed into 𢙴. Further corruption of the top component of 𢙴 turned the original phonetic 旡 into ⿱爫冖.
s_page_origin: A variant of 愛, replacing the lower-half component 𢖻 with 友 (“friend”).
note: glyph_origin is from the traditional page 愛; s_page_origin explains the simplified 爱.
